meta_description: Portfolio of Trevor King, a CAD designer moving into 3D visualization in Denver, Colorado.

hero.image_alt: Dark standing-seam cabin on a wooded hillside at dusk, boulders in the foreground
hero.name: Trevor King
hero.intro: I draft civil and transportation plans at Kimley-Horn, and for the past six months I've also been building SketchUp and 3ds Max models of our civil projects for marketing. Visualization is where I'm taking my career.

about.label: About me
about.heading: From plan sheets
about.lede: I already work on both sides: drafting the plans, then turning them into 3D models that show people what will be built. Now I want visualization to be the whole job.
paragraphs: My degree in CAD and architecture was built around 3D modeling: SketchUp, 3ds Max, AutoCAD 3D and several rendering programs, along with photography and Photoshop. Drafting at Kimley-Horn taught me to read engineering plans closely and get the details right, because someone builds from them. For the past six months I've put both together, modeling civil projects in SketchUp and 3ds Max for marketing.

Photography taught me to look at light and composition. Visualization is where it all comes together: accurate models from real drawings, presented so a client, a city council or a neighbor can see what's coming.

timeline.title: Moving into visualization
timeline.text: Looking for a full-time visualization role. Building new work in SketchUp, 3ds Max, D5 and Enscape, and finishing my FAA Part 107 drone certification for aerial capture.

timeline.title: 3D Modeling for Marketing
timeline.text: Building SketchUp and 3ds Max models of civil projects for marketing and presentations, alongside my drafting work.

timeline.title: CAD Technician & Designer
timeline.text: Drawing sets in Civil 3D and AutoCAD for civil, roadway and transit projects. Led drafting on a project team, splitting the work and reviewing it to hit submittals.

timeline.title: A.S., CAD & Architecture
timeline.where: Front Range Community College · Fort Collins, CO
timeline.text: Coursework centered on 3D modeling and rendering in SketchUp, 3ds Max and AutoCAD 3D, plus Revit, photography and Photoshop. Autodesk AutoCAD Certified User.

steps.label: 01 · Source data
steps.title: CAD, BIM and site data
steps.text: Civil 3D surfaces and alignments, AutoCAD linework, Revit models, Google Earth and aerial imagery. I read the plans before I model anything.

steps.label: 02 · Model
steps.title: Clean, accurate 3D
steps.text: Buildings, roadways and site context built to the design and kept light enough to render in real time.

steps.label: 03 · Render
steps.title: Materials, light and story
steps.text: Real-time scenes with scanned vegetation and materials, lit and framed to explain the project.

steps.label: 04 · Finish
steps.title: Post and delivery
steps.text: Color, entourage and cleanup in Photoshop, then stills, comparisons or interactive 3D for the web.

extras.title: AI-assisted workflows
extras.text: I use AI tools in production: D5's AI material and atmosphere matching, and AI-assisted conversion of CAD linework into 3D models.

extras.title: Automation
extras.text: Custom 3ds Max scripts that speed up modeling, like SketchUp-style push/pull inside Max.

extras.title: Aerial capture
extras.text: FAA Part 107 drone certification in progress, for site photos, reality capture and photo-matching.

work.label: Selected work

work.intro: Each project below was chosen to show one thing I can do for a team: match reality, design something new, handle a complex model, and push the tools further than usual.
